messages:
Ari (Hiring Manager): New Senior Platform Eng starts Monday. Need a short manager-friendly 5-day sprint + 30/60/90 that I can paste in calendar and team channels.
Priya (People Ops): Got you. Super compact manager paste:
Priya (People Ops): ```Day 0 (preboard) - confirm laptop, SSO, Slack + repo access, badge
Day 1 - 9am manager 30m (role, context, immediate 1wk micro-goal); buddy tour; EOD 15m check-in
Days 2-3 - complete access list, run local dev, pair w/ domain SME, shadow on-call, open first tiny PR
Days 4-5 - finish PR, update one runbook, present 10m at Fri demo, 1:1 to set 30d focus
30/60/90 summary - 30d: 2 small PRs, one runbook; 60d: lead a small rollout/incident; 90d: own a service surface + measurable improvement
Manager 1:1 cadence - week1: daily 15m; weeks2-4: 2x/week 30m; after 30d: weekly 30-60m```
Dev (IT): I can pre-stage laptop & VPN Friday if you DM job code + office.
Tom (Senior Eng): Add "first-task" idea: tiny perf test or config fix that ships in week1, paired with a SME.
Ari (Hiring Manager): Nice. Can we include a one-line autonomy expectation for day90?
Priya (People Ops): Done: "By day 90 the hire should be independently owning a core surface with a clear metric to improve."
onboard-bot: welcome packet queued and manager calendar template attached.
Ari (Hiring Manager): Thanks — I'll paste this into the offer acceptance and the team intro. Tom, can you schedule the pair sessions?
Tom (Senior Eng): On it. Will block Tue/Thu pairing slots.
